name: ripple-referral-app
description: Cross-platform referral and affiliate code sharing application

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w backend & npm run dev -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w mobile && npm run build -w desktop
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w web && npm run test -w mobile
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w web && npm run lint -w mobile && npm run lint -w desktop
